reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (candidate-side API: search, details, apply with questions, application tracking, CV editing).
auth: 1. **App authentication** on every call: `Authorization: Basic base64(client_id:client_secret)` (realm "InfoJobs-API").

2. **User authorization** (private data, applying): OAuth 2.0 authorization code — redirect to `https://www.infojobs.net/api/oauth/user-authorize/index.xhtml?scope=<comma list>&redirect_uri=<callback>&client_id=…&response_type=code`, receive the verification code on the callback (desktop apps may us
3. Scopes are listed per operation (e.g. `my_applications` for applying and reading applications, CV scopes for `/curriculum`); user role `role_candidate`.

endpoints.notes: `q`, `province` (repeatable, values from /dictionary/province), `category` / `subcategory`, `city`, `country`, `salaryMin`, `salaryMax`, contract / workday / study / experience filters, `teleworking`, `order`, `page`, `maxResults`, `sinceDate`; response offers[] + facets
title, description, requirements, salary, contract, province, city, company, applications, link, hasKillerQuestions, questions
list of the user's applications, status timeline (read / in process / discarded …)

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened (the quick-start only says app credentials identify each call). - Free developer registration with an InfoJobs account; the API is explicitly for third-party candidate apps ("Build a job app for >2.5 million users … Job search, Job application & tracking, CV content & edition"). - Applying requires the user's OAuth consent (scope `my_applications`) — autopilot apply under the seeker's own token is the documented use. Killer questions must be answered from the profile (truth gate applies). - Site-wide "Condiciones de uso" and privacy terms apply; www.infojobs.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of an application registered at https://developer.infojobs.net/ ('App authentication is done via HTTP basic access authentication' with Client ID and Client secret).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client secret of the same InfoJobs application.

adapter.rate_note: No numeric rate limit is published on the operation pages. Two requests per second.

search.note: GET /api/9/offer (User role public, no scope): q keyword, page (the example answers currentPage 1), maxResults (default 20; 'We strongly recommend limiting to 50 or fewer'). province/city/country take dictionary keys (/dictionary/*), so location/country are not sent. salaryMin/salaryMax are dictionary items ({id, value} text), left in raw; the list hit has no full description (requirementMin in raw).

get_posting.note: GET /api/7/offer/{offerId} (User role public). minPay/maxPay are Pay objects and stay in raw; externalUrlForm, when set, is where the application must be made.

not_offered.me: The app credentials identify the developer application only; candidate data (/candidate…) needs a user token from the InfoJobs OAuth authorization-code flow.
not_offered.apply: Applying (POST /application with killer questions, CV and cover letter) needs an authenticated candidate's OAuth token with the my_applications scope, which basic app authentication cannot supply.

evidence: probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 500 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/2 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
